title: EC135 Flight Dynamics — simulated flight test, test plan
aircraft: Airbus Helicopters EC135 P2+: 4-blade bearingless (hingeless-type) main rotor turning counterclockwise seen from above (corrected: the first version of this plan said clockwise, which is what the simulator then had; the card author found the error), R 5.1 m, 395 rpm (tip speed ~211 m/s); Fenestron ducted tail rotor (10 blades, 1.0 m); two turboshaft engines with FADEC; MTOW 2910 kg.

conventions.axes: Body axes: x forward, y right, z down. Roll + = right wing down; pitch + = nose up; yaw + = nose right. Rates p, q, r in deg/s.
conventions.controls: lon + = forward stick (nose down command), lat + = right stick, ped + = right pedal, col + = collective up. Cyclic and pedal inputs are fractions of the travel from centre to stop (1.0 = stop); collective inputs are fractions of its full range. Inputs are given relative to the trimmed position.
conventions.rigging: Lateral cyclic: 1.0 = 7.5 deg blade cyclic = 80 mm stick (ERF 1997). Longitudinal cyclic: range 21.8 deg total over 215 mm (ERF 1997); 0.1 = about 1.1 deg. Collective: full range about 14.5 deg of blade pitch at 0.75 R; 0.05 = about 0.7 deg. Pedal gearing is not published.
conventions.aids: 'bare' = no stability augmentation, no autopilot, controls exactly as scripted. 'pilot' = a scripted test pilot flies the named task closed-loop (described in words in each card).
conventions.standard: Unless stated: 2500 kg, mid CG, 1000 ft (305 m) pressure altitude, ISA, calm air, out of ground effect, both engines at 100 % NR governed by the FADEC.

cards.title: Hover trim out of ground effect
cards.inputs: none: the trimmed state is recorded for 5 s
cards.record: pitch and roll attitude, control positions (relative to centre), power required, rotor speed
cards.purpose: trim attitude, which skid is low, pedal and power in the hover

cards.title: Lateral cyclic pulse in the hover
cards.inputs: lat +0.10 (right) for 1.0 s, then back to trim; all other controls fixed; record 6 s
cards.record: p, phi, q, theta, r, lateral ground speed
cards.purpose: roll response to stick, damping, cross-coupling into pitch

cards.title: Longitudinal cyclic pulse in the hover
cards.inputs: lon +0.10 (forward) for 1.0 s, then back to trim; record 6 s
cards.record: q, theta, p, phi, forward ground speed
cards.purpose: pitch response to stick, cross-coupling into roll

cards.title: Pedal step in the hover
cards.inputs: ped +0.10 (right) held for 4 s; record 6 s
cards.record: r, heading, phi, vertical speed, NR, Fenestron power
cards.purpose: yaw response: acceleration, rate after 1, 2, 4 s; couplings

cards.title: Collective step in the hover, pedals fixed
cards.inputs: col +0.05 held; cyclic and pedals fixed; record 6 s
cards.record: vertical speed, vertical acceleration, r, NR, power
cards.purpose: heave response (time constant), yaw due to collective (direction and size), rotor speed droop

cards.title: Hover with the controls fixed after a small disturbance
cards.inputs: controls fixed at trim; at t = 0 a nose-up pitch rate of 2 deg/s is imposed; record 25 s
cards.record: theta, phi, u, v, q, p
cards.purpose: hover stability: the character of the motion (oscillatory or not), period, time to double

cards.title: Total power loss in the hover
cards.inputs: both engines fail at t = 0; controls fixed for 1.0 s; then collective lowered to full down over 1.0 s; cyclic and pedals fixed; record 5 s
cards.record: r, heading, NR, vertical speed, vertical acceleration
cards.purpose: yaw at torque loss (direction, rate), rotor speed decay before and after the lever goes down

cards.title: Vortex ring: vertical descent, recovery with collective only
cards.condition: standard; descent at zero ground speed
cards.inputs: pilot establishes a vertical descent of 1800 fpm at zero ground speed (heading and position held with cyclic and pedals), then at t = 0 raises the collective by 0.15 and holds it, still holding zero ground speed; record 20 s
cards.record: vertical speed, height lost, collective, power, NR, thrust fluctuation
cards.purpose: vortex-ring behaviour: does collective alone arrest the sink, how much height is lost

cards.title: Vortex ring: same entry, classical recovery
cards.inputs: same entry; at t = 0 the pilot pitches 10 deg nose down to gain forward speed and raises the collective by 0.15; record 20 s
cards.purpose: comparison with H8a: height lost, time to recover

cards.title: Acceleration from the hover to 40 kt at constant height
cards.inputs: pilot accelerates slowly (about 1 kt/s) from the hover to 40 kt holding height with the collective, heading with the pedals and wings level with the lateral cyclic; record until 40 kt
cards.record: power, collective, longitudinal and lateral cyclic, pedal, pitch and roll attitude against airspeed
cards.purpose: translational lift, flapback (forward stick needed), transverse-flow effect, pedal change

cards.title: Level flight power curve
cards.condition: standard, trimmed level flight at 0, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 135 kt
cards.inputs: none: trimmed state recorded at each speed
cards.purpose: power required curve: minimum-power speed, power at high speed, attitudes

cards.title: Longitudinal doublet at 100 kt
cards.inputs: lon +0.05 for 1.0 s, then -0.05 for 1.0 s, then back to trim; record 8 s
cards.record: q, theta, load factor, airspeed, p, phi
cards.purpose: short-term pitch response and damping; angle-of-attack stability

cards.title: Lateral pulse at 100 kt
cards.inputs: lat +0.10 for 1.0 s, then back to trim; record 8 s
cards.purpose: roll response in forward flight, adverse or proverse yaw

cards.title: Pedal doublet at 100 kt
cards.inputs: ped +0.10 for 1.0 s, then -0.10 for 1.0 s, then back to trim; record 12 s
cards.purpose: directional stability and the Dutch roll: period, damping, roll due to sideslip

cards.title: Speed stability at 80 kt
cards.inputs: controls fixed; at t = 0 the forward speed is increased by 5 m/s (an instantaneous disturbance); record 10 s
cards.purpose: speed stability: which way the nose goes after a speed increase

cards.title: Total power loss at 100 kt and autorotation
cards.inputs: both engines fail at t = 0; controls fixed for 1.0 s; then collective full down over 1.0 s; from then the pilot holds 65 kt with the cyclic, wings level and the ball centred with the pedals; record 40 s
cards.record: r, NR, airspeed, vertical speed, pedal, collective
cards.purpose: yaw at failure, rotor speed decay and recovery, steady autorotation: sink rate and NR

cards.title: Retreating blade stall in a pull-up at 140 kt
cards.condition: 2910 kg, 1000 ft ISA, 140 kt level, bare
cards.inputs: lon -0.25 (aft) held for 2.0 s, then back to trim; record 5 s
cards.record: load factor, q, theta, p, phi, stalled part of the disc
cards.purpose: what the aircraft does when the retreating blade stalls: direction of pitch and roll

cards.title: Low-g pushover and roll at low g
cards.inputs: lon +0.15 (forward) for 1.0 s; at the lowest load factor lat +0.15 for 1.0 s; record 5 s
cards.purpose: roll control power at low g for a hingeless rotor

cards.title: Steady 30-degree banked turn at 100 kt
cards.inputs: pilot rolls into a 30 deg right bank and holds bank, airspeed and height, ball centred; record 30 s
cards.record: turn rate, power, load factor, sideslip
cards.purpose: turn rate and power increase in a coordinated turn
